description.value: A premium adult-only bed and breakfast in Harrison Hot Springs, housed in a custom-built post-and-beam lodge designed and constructed by owners Kristy and Roy Molnar over seven years. The lodge is known for its complimentary home-cooked brunches made from locally sourced and garden-grown ingredients. Situated near Harrison Lake, it serves as a base for hiking, kayaking, fishing, and exploring the eastern Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a legitimate, licensed (2025) adult-only B&B in Harrison Hot Springs operated by hosts Kristy & Roy Molnar. Phone matches between OSM and website. No mention whatsoever of cycling, bike storage, or any bike-related amenities on the website, so all required criteria and bike-specific amenities are null. OSM tag internet_access=wlan exists but Wi-Fi is not explicitly confirmed on the website, so marked null per rules. The OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the website clearly states Harrison Hot Springs (District of Kent - Agassiz), which is a different community. Contact page email (therockwellharrison@gmail.com) differs from OSM email (Rockwell-Harrison@shaw.ca), though the about page also lists the shaw.ca address.
